name: Paul Edgecomb Struggles to Urinate in the Toilet
description: Paul Edgecomb, in his guard's uniform, stands in a cramped toilet, trying to urinate. His face is pained, his forehead beaded with sweat, as he strains in discomfort.
related_events: Paul Edgecomb struggles to urinate while on duty

name: Paul Walks the Hospital Corridor
description: Paul enters a hospital corridor where elderly and infirm residents move slowly around him. He walks with a sprightly step, murmuring occasional greetings as he passes a woman using a walker and a man shuffling alongside a rolling I.V. stand. The floor is a dull, institutional green. He continues down the hall, acknowledging those around him.
related_events: Paul enters the hospital corridor and greets residents

name: Paul Approaches the Warden's Office
description: Paul walks up the stairs toward the warden's office.
related_events: Paul ascends stairs to the warden's office

name: Paul Arrives in Trapingus County
description: Paul drives his Model T along a road. The car putters as it approaches a sign that reads 'Trapingus County Welcomes You.' He passes the sign and continues on into the county.
related_events: Paul's Model T approaches Trapingus County

name: The Prison Truck Arrives
description: A prison truck bounces along a rough, uneven dirt road, its wheels jolting over deep ruts. The vehicle moves steadily toward the main gate of a prison in the American South. Barbed wire and guard towers come into view as the truck nears the entrance. The air is dry, the land flat and worn. Inside, figures sit in silence, their faces shadowed. The engine growls as the truck slows, approaching the gate.
related_events: Prison truck travels toward main gate on rutted dirt road

name: Paul Grooms Himself at the Bathroom Mirror
description: Paul stands in front of the bathroom mirror, carefully buttoning his shirt. He picks up a hairbrush and runs it through his hair, smoothing it into place.
related_events: Paul buttons his shirt at the bathroom mirror
Paul tidies his hair with a hairbrush

name: Jan Confronts Paul About Missing Doctor's Visit
description: After an intimate moment, Jan catches her breath and looks over at Paul. She remarks that they haven’t been this active since they were nineteen and asks what’s going on. Paul hesitates, then admits he never made it to the doctor yesterday.
related_events: Jan confronts Paul about his unusual behavior
Paul reveals he did not visit the doctor as expected

name: Paul's Escape Through the Back Door
description: Paul moves quietly to the back door. He takes a red plastic rain poncho from a peg on the wall and puts it on. Then he steps outside and closes the door behind him, unseen.
related_events: Paul escapes through the back door
Paul takes a red plastic rain poncho from the wall

name: Intimate Encounter with a Moment of Pause
description: They move together in a tangle of limbs, breathing hard, skin slick with sweat. Moans fill the room as their bodies collide, relentless and urgent. She pushes him down onto the bed, holding him flat beneath her. For a moment, she stills, catching her breath. 'Those must've been some pills,' she says. Then they resume, driving into the heat and motion once more.
related_events: Characters engage in intense physical intimacy

name: Paul Edgecomb Wakes to a Rainy Morning Forecast
description: A clock radio blares the morning weather report, announcing rain. Paul Edgecomb, in his late 70s or early 80s, stirs and opens his eyes, beginning a new day.
related_events: Paul Edgecomb wakes up to start a new day
Clock radio announces morning weather forecast

name: Transporting Billy Wharton in Prison Truck
description: The prison truck appears, swaying along the rutted road. Inside, Billy Wharton sits motionless, his eyes fixed on nothing, drool dripping from his slack mouth in long, slow strings.
related_events: Prison truck arrives along rutted road
Billy Wharton exhibits unresponsive behavior during transport

name: Paul's Painful Attempt to Urinate
description: Paul stands at the toilet trying to urinate, but only a few drops fall into the bowl. He winces in pain, unable to continue. He steps away, picks up a towel, and wipes sweat from his face, which is hot with fever.
related_events: Paul attempts to urinate but experiences excruciating pain
Paul wipes sweat from his feverish face with a towel

name: Paul Hurries Downstairs with Urgency
description: Paul lies awake, watching Jan sleep. He looks unwell, his skin pale and damp with fever. He shifts in bed, suddenly aware of a strong need to urinate. As he sits up, a sharp pain stabs his groin. He winces, clutching at the area, then moves quickly to the edge of the bed. He descends the stairs in haste, one hand gripping the railing, the other pressed against himself, moving with urgency.
related_events: Paul wakes up feeling unwell and realizes he needs to urinate
Paul experiences pain while getting out of bed
Paul hurries down the stairs while clutching himself

name: Klaus Responds to a Woman's Scream
description: Klaus Detterick walks from his house to the barn carrying a milking pail. The morning is quiet, the sky brightening, chickens clucking in the front yard. He disappears into the barn. A woman's scream suddenly cuts through the stillness. Klaus reappears, drops the pail, and runs toward the house.
related_events: Klaus Detterick walks from his house to the barn with a milking pail
Woman's scream shatters the morning silence
Klaus drops the milking pail and runs toward the house

name: Paul and Elaine's Morning Exchange
description: Paul walks into the breakfast area where dozens of retirees are eating, sipping coffee or tea, some talking, others quiet. He spots Elaine Connelly, an elegant woman of eighty, sitting with a small group of ladies, drinking tea. She smiles at him, and he answers with a rakish wink that makes her smile widen. He reaches past people at the counter, grabs two pieces of cold toast from a serving plate, glances at Elaine with a look that says 'catch ya later,' and then leaves.
related_events: Paul enters the dining area and exchanges greetings with Elaine Connelly
Paul takes two pieces of leftover toast from the serving plate
Paul signals 'catch ya later' to Elaine before leaving

name: Bitterbuck Reunites with His Family
description: Bitterbuck is led in. His daughter rises, hesitates for a moment, then touches his face and kisses him. He takes her hands, kisses them, and holds back tears. The rest of the family—son-in-law, grandchildren, cousins—gather around him, murmuring hellos and shaking his hand.
related_events: Daughter touches and kisses Bitterbuck upon his arrival
Bitterbuck takes and kisses his daughter's hands
Family members gather around Bitterbuck and exchange greetings

name: Prisoners Work the Fields as Guards Patrol and a Truck Arrives
description: Hundred of prisoners swing their pickaxes in unison across the open field, the rhythmic strikes matching the cadence of a work song they sing together. Dust rises with each movement under the heat of the sun. On horseback, guards circle the perimeter, rifles resting across their shoulders, barrels pointed toward the sky. A late 1920s Ford prison truck rattles down the dirt road, kicking up a long plume of dust as it approaches the worksite, its rear axle sagging under a heavy load.
related_events: Prisoners labor in fields with pickaxes to the rhythm of a work song
Guards patrol on horseback with rifles pointed skyward
A 1920s Ford prison truck arrives along a dusty road

name: Paul and Janice Share a Quiet Moment in the Kitchen
description: Paul sits at the kitchen table in the early hours, drinking buttermilk and listening to soft music on the radio. Janice Edgecombe comes downstairs, barefoot and sleepy, and steps into the kitchen. She notices the music and asks if it’s too loud, then remarks on the empty space in their bed where Paul should be. He tells her he’s having trouble sleeping. She strokes his hair, then sits on his lap, giving him a crooked smile. He mentions being worried about Melinda and Hal, and also reveals a new inmate arrived that day—big and simple-minded. Janice asks if she wants to know more, and Paul says no, adding that one sleepless person in the house is enough. He reflects quietly on the troubling things in the world. She kisses him just above his left eyebrow, a spot that always affects him. She urges him to come back to bed, teasing that she can help him sleep. He declines, saying he’s unwell—something wrong with his waterworks—and doesn’t want to make her sick. He refuses to see Doctor Sadler, knowing the treatment would make him sick in a different way. She kisses him again in that same spot. He smiles. She calls him a poor old guy.
related_events: Paul drinks buttermilk and listens to soft music in the kitchen at night
Janice Edgecombe enters the kitchen and converses with Paul
Janice sits on Paul's lap and shares a moment of intimacy
Paul reveals concern about a new inmate and personal health issue
Janice expresses care and offers comfort to Paul

name: Paul Exits the Toilet and Responds to Coffey
description: Paul steps gingerly from the toilet. Del watches him, saying, "Don' look so good, boss. Look like you runnin' you a fever." Paul gives him a sharp, weary look. From further down the Mile, John Coffey's voice calls out softly, "Boss Edgecomb? Needs ta see you down here, boss." Paul answers, "Got things to tend to just now, John Coffey. You be still in your cell now, y'hear?" Coffey falls silent. Paul walks to the entrance door and peers through the viewing slot.
related_events: Paul exits toilet while Del observes his condition
John Coffey calls out to Paul from his cell
Paul responds to John Coffey's request with refusal
Paul checks through the entrance door viewing slot

name: Paul Reads Coffey's File on the Bleachers
description: Paul sits by himself on the bleachers in the prison yard, a brown-bagged sandwich in his hands. He unwraps the sandwich and places Coffey's file on his knees, then begins to read through the documents as guards watch from a distance.
related_events: Paul sits alone on bleachers reviewing Coffey's file
Paul begins reading Coffey's file while unwrapping sandwich

name: Arlen Bitterbuck Walks the Perimeter Under Guard
description: Arlen Bitterbuck walks along the edge of the fenced-off section of the prison yard set aside for inmates. Guard Bill Dodge watches him closely from nearby, standing alert as Bitterbuck moves in a slow, steady circuit around the perimeter.
related_events: Arlen Bitterbuck walks perimeter of inmate area under supervision

name: Paul Gets Ready for Work While Sick
description: Paul buttons up his uniform jacket, looking feverish and clammy. Jan packs his lunch, watching him with concern. She hands him the brown-bagged meal and kisses his face before he leaves.
related_events: Paul buttons uniform jacket while appearing ill
Jan packs Paul's lunch and expresses concern

name: Paul Promises to See a Doctor After Work
description: Paul buttons up his uniform jacket, looking feverish and clammy. Jan packs his lunch and watches him with concern. He tells her he is going to the doctor, but only after they settle the new inmate. She asks if he’s that sick, and he replies, 'Oh yeah.' She hands him his brown-bagged lunch and kisses his face before he leaves for work.
related_events: Paul decides to go to the doctor after work
Jan kisses Paul before he leaves for work

name: Paul Requests Sick Leave and Hands Off Work
description: Paul makes a phone call to Paul, telling him he might be sick and asking to take the morning off. He requests that Paul cover his responsibilities for the day. After Paul agrees, Paul hangs up the phone and turns to Jan, who is standing nearby.
related_events: Paul calls Paul to request sick leave and ask for coverage
Paul hangs up the phone and turns to Jan

name: Paul Questions His Decision After Calling In Sick
description: After hanging up the phone, Paul turns to Jan. She asks if he’s sure he should take the morning off. He replies that he’s not sure what he’s sure of.
related_events: Jan questions Paul's decision to take sick leave
Paul expresses uncertainty about his own feelings and decisions

name: Maintaining Old Sparky
description: Jack Van Hay and a small crew work on Old Sparky. Paul carefully sands a connector plug while Dean rubs wax into the chair's wooden arms, polishing them to a shine. The hum of quiet labor fills the room until a faint laugh seems to drift in from E Block. Paul and Dean pause, listening. Then Brutal's voice calls softly to them.
related_events: Jack Van Hay and crew perform maintenance on Old Sparky
Paul sands a connector plug on Old Sparky
Dean waxes Old Sparky's wooden arms

name: A Laugh in the Silence
description: Paul carefully sanded a connector plug on Old Sparky while Dean polished the wooden arms until they shone. The hum of maintenance filled the room until a faint laugh, seemingly from E Block, drifted through the air. Both men froze, hands still, eyes lifting toward the sound. A beat passed. Then Brutal's voice came softly from nearby, calling their names, and they turned toward him, the moment broken.
related_events: Paul and Dean hear a laugh from E Block
Brutal calls softly to Paul and Dean

name: Dressing Billy the Kid
description: Harry, Dean, and Percy enter the room where William Wharton stands motionless in a hospital gown, staring out the window. Harry waves his fingers in front of Wharton's face, receiving no response. Handing prison clothes to Harry, Dean passes over a folded shirt and pants. Harry calls out to Wharton, who turns slowly with a blank expression and takes the clothes. He fumbles with the shirt and drops the pants. Harry and Dean remove the hospital gown and guide Wharton's arms into the sleeves of the shirt. Percy mocks Wharton, calling him a 'limp noodle' and mimicking the electric chair, but Wharton shows no reaction. Percy then picks up the pants and helps, along with Harry and Dean, to dress Wharton one leg at a time.
related_events: Harry tests William Wharton's responsiveness
William Wharton fails to dress himself due to sedation
Harry and Dean dress William Wharton in prison clothes

name: Percy Taunts Wharton During Dressing
description: Harry and Dean begin dressing William Wharton in prison clothes, guiding his limp arms into the shirt sleeves. Percy picks up the pants and crouches down to help, one leg at a time. As he does, he stares up at Wharton and mimics a man being electrocuted, jerking and twitching with a buzzing sound. He laughs and asks Wharton how it feels to know he’ll die with his knees bent. Wharton looks at him with a blank expression as Harry and Dean continue dressing him without comment.
related_events: Dean asks Percy to assist in dressing William Wharton
Percy picks up prison pants to help dress William Wharton
Percy mocks William Wharton about his execution
Percy imitates the electric chair execution

name: Paul's Walk Up the Misty Ridge
description: Paul walks up a misty ridge, the trees shrouded in drizzle. He reaches a high point and pauses, looking back at the valley below. He takes a deep breath, then pulls a piece of toast from his pocket and begins to eat it as he continues climbing toward the treeline.
related_events: Paul begins his walk up the ridge in the mist
Paul reaches a vantage point overlooking the valley
Paul eats a piece of toast during his ascent

name: Brad Dolan Arrives at the Nursing Home
description: A pickup truck rumbles into view and parks near the nursing home. Brad Dolan, an orderly in jeans and a plaid shirt, steps out and looks up toward the ridge. He scowls, mutters a quiet insult about an old man, then slams the door behind him and walks toward the building.
related_events: Brad Dolan arrives at the nursing home in a pickup truck
Brad Dolan gazes up toward the ridge and mutters in disdain
Brad Dolan slams the truck door and walks toward the nursing home

name: Paul Delivers News and Bitterbuck Leaves the Block
description: Paul arrives at Bitterbuck's bar accompanied by a group of guards. He calls out to Bitterbuck, telling him that his daughter Arlen and her family are here. Bitterbuck steps out from his cell. Bill Dodge then takes him and escorts him off the block.
related_events: Paul arrives at Bitterbuck's bar with a group of guards
Paul informs Bitterbuck about his daughter and her family's arrival
Bitterbuck exits his cell
Bill Dodge escorts Bitterbuck off the block

name: Paul Orders Rehearsals During Bitterbuck's Absence
description: As soon as Bitterbuck steps out of his cell and is led away by Bill Dodge, Paul turns to the group of guards and gives a sharp command. 'Let's move. I want at least two rehearsals before he gets back.' The guards begin organizing the space, moving into position as Paul oversees the preparations.
related_events: Paul initiates preparations for rehearsals in Bitterbuck's absence

name: Paul Encounters a Buck in the Woods
description: Paul walks along a wooded path, munching on a piece of toast, when a rustling sound stops him in his tracks. He turns and sees a large buck standing twenty feet away, its breath visible in the cold morning air. The two remain perfectly still, watching each other in silence. After a long moment, the buck suddenly leaps and darts into the trees, disappearing into the foliage. Paul lets out a breath, shakes his head slowly in wonder, and takes another bite of toast as he continues down the path.
related_events: Paul encounters a buck in the woods
Buck bounds away into the foliage
Paul exhales and shakes his head in wonder

name: Paul Resumes His Walk After Seeing the Buck
description: Paul takes another bite of toast, then continues down the wooded path. He moves toward a pair of old wooden storage shacks ahead, the mist rising gently around him as the morning light filters through the trees.
related_events: Paul takes another bite of toast
Paul continues moving along the path

name: Paul Finds Hal at the Window
description: Paul enters the room and finds Hal standing by the window, staring out in silence. Hal turns and asks Paul to close the door. Paul does so, and the two are left alone in the quiet room.
related_events: Paul enters the room and finds Hal staring out the window
Hal asks Paul to close the door

name: Hal Relays Wharton's Criminal History Amid Emotional Breakdown
description: Paul enters the room and finds Hal standing by the window, his posture heavy and unsteady. Hal asks Paul to close the door, then begins to speak about the new prisoner arriving the next day—William Wharton. He describes Wharton’s violent past: a robbery in which three people were killed, including a pregnant woman, and the tattoo of 'Billy the Kid' on his left arm. As Hal speaks, his voice wavers, his thoughts slow, and he stumbles over the words. He looks down at the report but can no longer focus on the text. His voice fades, and he falls silent, tears rolling down his face.
related_events: Hal struggles to speak and relay information about William Wharton
Hal recounts William Wharton's criminal history
Hal's voice falters and he loses focus while speaking

name: Hal Reveals His Diagnosis and Breaks Down
description: Hal stands by the window, his voice unsteady as he tells Paul about the inoperable brain tumor deep in his brain, the size of a lemon. He says the doctors have given his wife until Christmas. Tears begin to fall as he speaks, his composure crumbling. Paul watches in silence. Hal’s breathing grows ragged, his body shaking with deep, uncontrollable sobs.
related_events: Hal reveals his brain tumor diagnosis to Paul
Hal breaks down in tears and sobs uncontrollably

name: Paul Remembers the Green Mile
description: Paul sits by the window, gazing out as rain falls over the lawn. Elaine watches him, waiting. After a long silence, he speaks, saying the past has a way of catching up. She asks if the film reminded him of something. He admits he hasn’t spoken about it in over sixty years. She takes his hand. He tells her he was a prison guard during the Depression. When she says she’s heard that before, he adds that he was in charge of death row, overseeing all the executions. He explains they called it the Green Mile because of the lime-colored floor. He mentions the electric chair, known as Old Sparky, and says 1935 was the worst year of his life—the year of John Coffey and the two dead girls.
related_events: Paul reflects on his past as a prison guard
Elaine offers emotional support to Paul
Paul reveals his role as supervisor of death row executions
related_occasions: The Case Of The Two Dead Girls

name: Paul Remembers the Green Mile and John Coffey
description: Paul sits by the window, rain falling outside, and continues to speak. He tells Elaine that death row was called the Green Mile because the floor was the color of faded limes. He recalls the electric chair, which the guards called Old Sparky. The year 1935, he says, stands out in his memory—it was the year he suffered a severe urinary infection, and also the year John Coffey arrived, along with the case of the two dead girls.
related_events: Paul recalls the nickname of death row as the Green Mile
Paul remembers the prison's electric chair called Old Sparky
Paul reflects on the significance of 1935
related_occasions: The Case Of The Two Dead Girls

name: Bitterbuck's Last Question
description: Bitterbuck, his head shaved, speaks quietly to Paul, asking if a man who truly repents could return to the happiest time of his life and stay there forever. Paul tells him he almost believes that very thing. Bitterbuck smiles. He takes a deep breath as Brutal appears at the door, checking his pocketwatch and nodding to Paul. Paul tells Bitterbuck it will be fine, and that he’ll do fine.
related_events: Bitterbuck asks Paul about repentance and the possibility of returning to a happy time in the afterlife
Paul lies to Bitterbuck about believing in redemption through repentance
Bitterbuck smiles after hearing Paul's reassuring response

name: Bitterbuck Remembers His Summer in the Mountains
description: Bitterbuck, his head now shaved, speaks quietly about a summer from his youth. He remembers being eighteen, spending time in the mountains with his young wife. Each night they made love, and afterward, she would lie bare-breasted in the firelight, talking with him until the sun rose. Paul listens without responding. Brutal appears at the door, checks his pocketwatch, and nods. Bitterbuck takes a deep breath, steadying himself. Paul tells him it will be fine. Bitterbuck says that summer was his best time.
related_events: Bitterbuck recalls his first summer with his young wife in the mountains

name: Bitterbuck's Final Moments Before Execution
description: Brutal appears at the door, checks his pocketwatch, and nods to Paul. Bitterbuck takes a deep breath, steadying himself. Paul tells him, 'It'll be fine. You'll do fine.'
related_events: Brutal checks his pocketwatch and nods to Paul
Bitterbuck prepares himself after reminiscing about his past
Paul reassures Bitterbuck that he will do fine

name: Brutal Places the Sponge and the Current is Activated
description: Brutal pulls the sponge from a bucket of brine, dripping wet, and places it on Bitterbuck's head. Water runs down the sides of Bitterbuck's mask and neck, pooling on the floor. The cap is lowered and the straps are secured. The switch is thrown. Bitterbuck surges forward against the restraints as the current passes through him.
related_events: Brutal places wet sponge on Bitterbuck's head
Execution current is activated causing Bitterbuck to surge against straps
related_occasions: Execution Of Bitterbuck

name: The Aftermath of the First Shock
description: Van Hay turned off the current after the first application, and Bitterbuck slumped forward, motionless in the chair. A doctor stepped up, felt for a pulse, then shook his head. Water dripped from the sponge onto the floor. Some of the witnesses looked away, their faces strained. Paul and Brutal locked eyes, saying nothing, each holding the silence between them as the room waited.
related_events: Van Hay deactivates execution current after first application
Doctor examines Bitterbuck for signs of life
Witnesses react to execution by turning away
related_occasions: Execution Of Bitterbuck

name: Second Surge
description: Brutal gives the order. Van Hay throws the switch again. Bitterbuck's body jerks forward violently, straining against the straps as the current surges through him. The room remains still, watching. After a moment, the current stops. Bitterbuck sags, motionless.
related_events: Execution current is reactivated for second time
related_occasions: Execution Of Bitterbuck

name: Klaus Responds to Marjorie's Panic Over Missing Daughters
description: Klaus bursts into the house and finds his wife Marjorie frantic, her voice trembling as she cries out that their daughters are gone. Without hesitation, she grabs him and pulls him through the house, her grip tight, leading him straight to the screened porch. There, their 12-year-old son Howie stands pointing at the floor, shouting, 'Papa! Papa, look! The blood!' Klaus stops cold, staring at the dark splatters on the ground and the screen door hanging crookedly from its hinges, torn open.
related_events: Klaus bursts into the house and discovers his wife in a state of panic
Marjorie alerts Klaus that their daughters are missing
Marjorie drags Klaus through the house to the screened porch

name: Klaus Finds Blood and a Broken Door on the Porch
description: Howie points at the floor and shouts to Klaus, drawing his attention to blood on the ground. Klaus steps onto the screened porch and sees the blood clearly, his eyes moving to the screen door, which hangs loose from its hinges. He stops in place, staring at the scene.
related_events: Howie points out blood and alerts Klaus
Klaus discovers blood and a damaged screen door on the porch

name: Paul Sits on the Bleachers Eating and Reading
description: Paul sits on the bleachers, chewing a bite of sandwich without looking up. He turns a page of his book, his eyes moving across the text as he continues reading.
related_events: Paul continues reading while eating a sandwich on the bleachers

name: Deputy McGee Takes Charge and Unleashes the Dogs
description: Cars and trucks skid to a stop, men jump out with rifles, and rush down the incline toward the field where Klaus is shouting and waving his arms. Deputy McGee slides down from the road, bellowing orders—'I want all the weapons unloaded, y'hear? Take out your shells, I won't have a man shot by accident today! Bobo, where them dogs?'—and the dogs come leaping from the back of a truck, howling as they race down the slope. The group surges forward through cattails and bulrushes, the dogs in the lead, pressing into the wetland as the chase unfolds.
related_events: Armed men arrive and initiate pursuit in the field
Deputy McGee assumes command at the scene
Dogs are released to lead the chase

name: The Chase Through the Wetlands
description: The group surges forward through thick cattails and bulrushes, the dogs bounding ahead as they scramble down the incline. Men follow close behind, rifles in hand, trampling through the marsh. The air fills with the sounds of crashing reeds, heavy footsteps, and the distant, frantic barking of the dogs leading the way.
related_events: Pursuit advances through cattails and bulrushes

name: Klaus Finds Katie's Fabric and the Nightgown in the Field
description: Klaus suddenly stops and holds up a small scrap of pale yellow fabric, shouting that it belongs to his daughter Katie. The group presses forward until they come upon a patch of trampled grass soaked with blood. Hanging from the low branches of a nearby tree is a little girl's bloody nightgown. The sight brings the men to a halt, their faces pale, some swaying as if about to collapse.
related_events: Klaus discovers a scrap of pale yellow fabric and identifies it as belonging to his daughter
Group encounters a blood-drenched patch of trampled grass and a little girl's bloody nightgown

name: The Howling in the Reeds
description: A sudden, inhuman howl tore through the air ahead, sharp and guttural, nothing like any sound the men or dogs had heard before. The dogs skidded to a halt, hackles raised, whining low in their throats. The men froze, rifles clutched tight, eyes scanning the cattails and shadowed brush. The noise came again—long, raw, and wrong—echoing across the marsh, stopping every foot in its tracks.
related_events: Inhuman howling erupts ahead, terrifying the pursuers and dogs

name: Brutal Defends Bitterbuck's Body from Percy's Mockery
description: Bitterbuck lies dead on a gurney. Percy reaches down and squeezes the corpse's cheek, saying, 'Adios, Chief. Drop us a card from hell, let us know if it's hot enough.' Brutal steps forward, knocks Percy's hand away, and shoves him aside. 'He's paid what he's owed. He's square with the house again, so keep your goddamn hands off him,' Brutal says. He pulls the sheet over Bitterbuck's face and wheels the gurney down the tunnel. Percy turns to Paul, asking, 'What's up his ass?' Paul replies, 'You, Percy. Always you,' and walks past. Percy calls after him, questioning if Paul hates the new guy, but Paul turns back and suggests Percy move on to Briar Ridge. Percy says he might, but only if Paul gives him Brutal's spot for the next execution. Paul hesitates, asking what's gotten into him. Percy insists he just wants to be out front once. Paul warns that if he refuses, Percy might stay for good. Without answering, Paul shakes his head and walks away.
related_events: Percy mocks Bitterbuck's corpse
Brutal confronts Percy over mistreatment of the body
Brutal covers Bitterbuck's body and removes the gurney

name: Percy Demands to Take Brutal's Place at the Next Execution
description: Percy watches as Brutal covers Bitterbuck’s body and wheels the gurney down the tunnel. He turns to Paul and asks what’s eating Brutal, why he always acts like that around him. Paul tells him it’s because of Percy himself. As Paul starts to walk away, Percy calls after him, asking if he really has to hate the new guy. Paul stops and suggests Percy move on, maybe take a job at Briar Ridge. Percy says he might, but only if Paul gives him Brutal’s spot at the next execution. Paul turns, surprised, and asks what’s gotten into him—whether seeing a man die isn’t enough, if he wants to be close enough to smell him burn. Percy insists he just wants to be out front, just once, and then he’ll be gone. When Paul asks what happens if he says no, Percy replies that he might stay for good, make a career of it. Paul shakes his head and walks off without answering.
related_events: Percy questions Paul about Brutal's hostility
Percy requests to take Brutal's position during the next execution
Paul reacts with disbelief to Percy's execution request

name: Paul Confronts Percy Over Execution Role
description: Paul tells Percy about a job at Briar Ridge, suggesting he take it. Percy responds by demanding Brutal's position for the next execution, insisting he wants to be out front just once. When Paul refuses, Percy smirks and says he might stay for good, making a career of it. Paul looks at him, shakes his head in disbelief, and walks away without another word.
related_events: Paul suggests Percy transfer to Briar Ridge
Percy threatens to remain permanently if denied execution role
Paul blames Percy for ongoing conflict
Paul walks away in stunned silence after Percy's threat

name: Klaus and Howie Arm Themselves, Marjorie Called to Report Westward Pursuit
description: Amid screaming and confusion in the house, Klaus grabs shotgun shells while Howie loads a .22 rifle. Klaus shouts at Marjorie to get on the phone and tell the authorities they are heading west. Marjorie stumbles through the house, reaching for the phone as Klaus and Howie run out onto the porch and race across the yard, following a trail of blood.
related_events: Klaus gathers shotgun shells during household chaos
Howie loads .22 rifle in response to emergency
Klaus yells at Marjorie to call and report their movement west

name: Marjorie Stumbles to the Phone and Reports the Abduction
description: Marjorie sobbed uncontrollably as she moved through the house, stumbling in her urgency. She reached for the phone, clutching it tightly, and called out to the central operator. Her voice trembled as she reported that someone had taken her little girls.
related_events: Marjorie breaks down in hysterical sobbing
Marjorie stumbles through house attempting to call for help
Marjorie reports abduction of her daughters to central operator

name: Klaus and His Son Chase the Blood Trail
description: Klaus and his son run from the house, sprinting across the yard as they follow a trail of blood left in the grass. They move quickly, heading away from the porch and into the open, their footsteps pounding the ground as they follow the spatters leading west.
related_events: Klaus and son flee house following blood trail

name: Paul Sits on the Bleachers, Turns a Page
description: While the house erupts in panic, Paul remains on the bleachers, sits quietly, lets out a long breath, and turns a page.
related_events: Paul exhales and turns page while on bleachers

name: Man Urinates by Woodpile and Collapses in Pain
description: Rushing from the kitchen toward the outhouse, the man stops near the woodpile to urinate. As he does, a sudden and intense pain strikes him. He buckles to his knees, his hand flailing against the woodpile to keep from falling face-first into his own urine. He clutches his mouth to stifle a scream, then collapses onto his side on the grass, breathing in ragged gasps with both hands pressed to his groin. The pain gradually subsides, leaving him trembling and drenched in sweat as he stares up at the sky in silence.
related_events: Man stops to urinate near woodpile while rushing to outhouse
Man experiences sudden, intense pain during urination
Man prevents falling face-first into urine with hand on woodpile

name: Man Endures Pain in Silence
description: The man stands near the woodpile, urinating as a sudden, searing pain strikes. He buckles to his knees, one hand bracing against the woodpile, the other clamped over his mouth to hold back a scream. His body trembles as he forces himself to remain quiet, his breath ragged through his fingers. He finishes urinating, then collapses onto his side on the grass, both hands pressed to his groin. He lies still, staring up at the sky, sweat soaking his skin, whispering 'oh God... oh God...' into the dark. No one answers.
related_events: Man suppresses scream to avoid waking wife
Man empties bladder while enduring intense pain

name: Man Collapses After Urinating by the Woodpile
description: After finishing urination, the man collapses onto his side and rolls onto the grass. He lies there, staring up at the sky, his body trembling and soaked in sweat as the pain slowly fades. His breath comes in ragged gasps. He whispers, 'oh God... oh God...' into the night. The sky remains silent. Only darkness surrounds him.
related_events: Man collapses onto grass after urination
Man stares at sky in physical and emotional distress
Pain gradually diminishes but leaves man trembling and sweating
Man whispers plea to God into the silent night

name: Paul Comes Home Distracted, Jan Asks How He Is
description: Paul comes home from work and stands at the kitchen door, looking numb. Jan is at the counter, slicing vegetables for dinner. She glances at him and says, 'Hi, honey. How are you feeling?' Paul replies, 'Um...not too bad.' She turns back to the counter. He doesn't say anything else. She continues preparing dinner.
related_events: Paul returns home from work appearing emotionally detached
Jan greets Paul and inquires about his well-being

name: Paul Ignores Jan's Question and Stares at Her
description: Jan stands at the counter slicing vegetables for dinner. She asks Paul how he’s feeling and what the doctor said. Paul doesn’t answer. He looks at her without speaking, his eyes moving down to her body. He watches her as she works, saying nothing. She turns back to the counter, continuing to prepare the meal, while Paul remains silent, still looking at her.
related_events: Paul avoids answering Jan's question about the doctor
Paul stares at Jan while she prepares dinner

name: Paul Initiates Intimacy While Jan Prepares Dinner
description: Paul walks up behind Jan as she stands at the counter slicing vegetables. He presses against her and slides his hands along her hips. She startles, turning slightly. He begins kissing the back of her neck, and she shivers, breathing becoming softer. She turns in his arms, and they kiss deeply.
related_events: Paul approaches Jan from behind and touches her hips
Paul kisses Jan on the back of the neck
Jan responds to Paul with surprise and mixed feelings

name: Paul and Jan Share a Passionate Embrace
description: Jan turned into Paul's arms, and they began kissing passionately. The kiss grew more intense, and soon they were urgently pulling each other's clothes off.
related_events: Jan turns and engages in passionate kissing with Paul

name: Armed Men Burst Through Cattails in Urgent Search
description: A man with a shotgun crashes through the cattails, wiping across the frame before disappearing. Another man follows, armed with a rifle, pushing through the brush and exiting in the same direction. A third man with a rifle comes after, moving quickly through the undergrowth. More men flood into view, moving with a dreamlike, slow-motion grace, some struggling to manage a team of dogs on tangled leads. Deputy Rob McGee shouts for everyone to stay together as they press forward into the reeds.
related_events: Man with a shotgun crashes through cattails and exits frame
Second man with rifle enters and exits through brush
Third man with rifle follows through the brush
Group of men floods into view with dreamlike, slow-motion movement

name: Klaus Deterick Finds a Yellow Fabric Scrap in the Nettles
description: Klaus Deterick moves through the cattails, the double-barrel shotgun cradled in his arm. He stops suddenly, his eyes fixed on a pale yellow scrap of fabric caught in the nettles. He reaches down, pulls it free, and holds it in his hand. His face twists in horror. He turns back, shouting into the reeds, his voice breaking with anguish.
related_events: Klaus Deterick discovers yellow fabric scrap in nettles
Klaus Deterick removes fabric scrap and reacts in anguish

name: Man Untangles Dog Leads as Deputy Shouts for Order
description: A man leads a team of dogs through the brush, tugging at the tangled leads as he tries to keep them under control. Around him, more men push through the cattails, moving swiftly. Deputy Rob McGee calls out, his voice sharp over the rustling reeds, urging everyone to stay together.
related_events: Man leading team of dogs struggles to untangle leads
Deputy Rob McGee shouts for group to stay together

name: A Whispered Threat In the Marsh
description: A sibilant voice whispers just below the surface of the air: 'You love your sister? You make any noise, know what happens?' The words coil through the stillness, barely audible over the hum of insects and the rustle of men pushing through the cattails. The fabric of a pale yellow scrap trembles in the nettles. Men with rifles and shotguns surge past, boots crushing wet reeds, dogs straining at tangled leads. Deputy Rob McGee calls out for the group to stay together. Klaus Detterick stands frozen, the cloth clutched in his hand, his mouth open in a silent cry. The whisper lingers, cold and close, as more men wade into the marsh, their movements slow, their eyes scanning the reeds.
related_events: Whispering voice threatens harm in response to noise

name: Percy Sets the Traps and Waits
description: Percy places a line of mousetraps baited with bacon along the Mile, carefully spacing each one. He crawls back to the desk and crouches against it, holding his breath as he stares at the restraint room door. The camera moves down to floor level, revealing the mouse already under the desk, peering out in the same direction as Percy. It hops forward a few steps, both mouse and man motionless, watching. Percy slowly turns his head and sees the mouse. The mouse turns and looks up at him. They both spring into motion, racing down the Mile, Percy shouting and stomping, traps snapping and flying into the air as they pass. The mouse darts ahead and wins. Percy stops, breathing hard, and notices Coffey watching from his cell. "Saw me a mouse go by," Coffey says. Percy erupts, kicking and punching the restraint room door in a fit of rage.
related_events: Percy lays down a series of mousetraps baited with bacon
Percy waits in hiding against the desk

name: Percy and the Mouse Lock Eyes
description: The camera moves to floor level, revealing the mouse already under the desk, its gaze fixed toward the restraint room door, just like Percy. The mouse creeps out slowly, inching forward to see better. A moment of stillness follows. Percy turns his head and looks down. The mouse turns and looks up. Their eyes meet. In an instant, the calm shatters. Percy yells and leaps to his feet, the mouse darts away, and the two race along the Mile, stomping and scrambling past cells, sending mousetraps snapping into the air. The mouse reaches the end first. Percy stops, breathing hard, then turns and sees Coffey watching him from inside his cell. "Saw me a mouse go by," Coffey says. Percy erupts, kicking and punching the restraint room door in a furious rage.
related_events: Mouse emerges from under the desk and observes the restraint room
Percy and the mouse make eye contact

name: Percy Chases the Mouse Through the Mile
description: The moment Percy and the mouse lock eyes, the chase erupts again. Percy stomps and shouts, racing down the Mile in pursuit. Mousetraps snap under their frantic movement, flinging into the air as they blur past the cells. The mouse darts ahead, reaching the end first, just as before, leaving Percy behind in defeat.
related_events: Percy and the mouse race through the Mile with mousetraps snapping
The mouse wins the race through the Mile

name: Percy's Rage After the Mouse Chase
description: After the mouse darts away and leaves him behind, Percy stands still for a moment, breathing hard. He turns and sees Coffey watching him silently from inside his cell. Percy's face twists in fury. He lunges at the restraint room door, kicking and punching it, shouting as he unleashes a violent storm of blows against the metal.
related_events: Percy sees Coffey staring at him from his cell
Percy attacks the restraint room door in a rage

name: Brad Dolan Confronts Paul About the Poncho
description: Paul approaches the back door after a walk and reaches for the knob. Brad Dolan lunges from behind the dumpster, grabs Paul's wrist, and refuses to let go. Brad accuses Paul of taking a staff poncho, insisting it doesn't belong to him. Paul tries to pull away, saying he only borrowed it and doesn't see the harm. Brad tightens his grip, insisting it's about following rules. He scolds Paul for being in the woods, especially in the rain, and demands to know what he was doing up there. Paul cries out that Brad is hurting him. Brad leans in and threatens that if Paul tells anyone about the incident, he will claim Paul is having senile delusions. Elaine appears at the screen door with a cup of tea, asking if Paul is coming in. Paul tells her he was just chatting with Mr. Dolan about the weather and that they're finished. Brad releases Paul, gives a final warning, and walks away. Paul watches him go. Elaine steps outside, her face pale. Paul gives her a strained but grateful smile.
related_events: Brad Dolan confronts Paul at the back door
Brad Dolan accuses Paul of violating rules by borrowing a staff poncho
Paul attempts to pull away from Brad Dolan
Paul reports physical pain from Brad Dolan's grip
Brad Dolan verbally abuses Paul during the confrontation

name: Paul Shows the Crushed Toast and Lies About the Argument
description: After Brad Dolan walks away, Paul opens his hand to reveal the crushed remains of a piece of toast, his palm greasy from the smeared spread. Elaine steps out from the house, holding a cup of tea, and looks at him with a pale, concerned face. Paul gives her a strained smile, then says they were just talking about the weather.
related_events: Paul reveals crushed toast in his hand
Paul claims he was chatting with Brad Dolan about the weather

name: Elaine Offers Tea and Steps Outside with Concern
description: Elaine stands in the screen door holding a cup of tea, calling out to Paul. She says she saw him coming back and thought he might like it. After a pause, she asks if he is coming in. Paul replies that he was just chatting with Mr. Dolan about the weather and that they are finished now. Brad lets go of Paul’s wrist, leans in close to whisper something, then walks away. Once Brad is gone, Elaine steps out of the house, her face pale. Paul turns to her and gives a strained but grateful smile.
related_events: Elaine offers tea to Paul
Elaine steps out of the house with concern
Paul gives Elaine a strained but grateful smile

name: Brad Dolan Threatens Paul with Accusations of Senility
description: As Paul stands by the back door, Brad Dolan releases his wrist and leans in close. 'Paulie? You tell anyone I squeezed your po' ol' hand, I'll tell 'em you're having senile delusions. Who you think they'll believe?' Dolan steps away and walks off. Paul watches him go, then turns as the screen door opens and Elaine steps out. He gives her a strained, grateful smile.
related_events: Brad Dolan threatens Paul with disbelief and accusations of senility

name: Pete Complains About the TV Show
description: Pete grumbles to a group of elderly ladies about watching the Jerry Springer show, calling it trash and questioning why they always have to watch such programs. The ladies respond that they find it interesting, defending their choice. As the discussion continues, Pete gets up and starts flipping through the channels, searching for something different, while the women direct him to the Movie Classic channel, urging him to go past the Home Shopping network. He lands on an old black and white musical, and the room brightens with recognition and delight.
related_events: Pete complains about Jerry Springer show to elderly ladies
related_occasions: Senior Living Room Television Viewing Session

name: Pete Switches to 'Top Hat'
description: Pete turns the channel to the Movie Classic channel at the request of a group of elderly ladies. The television now shows the film 'Top Hat,' and the residents settle in to watch. Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers appear on screen, dancing in a black and white musical number. The room fills with a quiet sense of enjoyment as the older people watch the performance.
related_events: Pete changes TV channel to Movie Classic channel
related_occasions: Senior Living Room Television Viewing Session

name: Paul Breaks Down During 'Top Hat' Movie
description: Paul and Elaine sit near the back of the senior living room, quietly talking as the others watch television. Pete switches the channel from Jerry Springer to the Movie Classic channel, where Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers begin dancing in 'Top Hat.' The room brightens with delight, but Paul grows still. His gaze locks on the screen as Astaire sings 'Cheek to Cheek' and the couple glides across the floor. His expression shifts—recognition, then distress. Elaine notices, calling his name, but he doesn't answer. The music fills the room, and suddenly Paul begins to sob, covering his face, his shoulders shaking. The room falls silent. Orderlies rush over. One, Brad Dolan, touches Paul’s shoulder with a mocking tone, but Elaine shoves his hand away, snapping at him to leave Paul alone. Brad steps back. Elaine helps Paul to his feet and leads him out of the room as the movie continues to play.
related_events: Paul recognizes something deeply personal in the 'Top Hat' dance scene
Elaine expresses concern about Paul's reaction to the movie
related_occasions: Senior Living Room Television Viewing Session

name: Paul Breaks Down During Movie, Elaine Defends Him
description: Paul suddenly bursts into tears while watching the film, his sobs filling the quiet room. Everyone turns to look, the movie forgotten. An orderly rushes over, asking what’s wrong. Brad Dolan steps in, placing a hand on Paul’s shoulder and leaning in with a mocking tone, asking why he’s crying. Elaine immediately shoves Brad’s hand away, her voice sharp as she tells him Paul doesn’t need his help. She helps Paul to his feet and leads him out of the room, the others watching in silence.
related_events: Paul suddenly breaks down in tears during the viewing session
Orderly rushes to check on Paul after his emotional breakdown
Brad Dolan mockingly questions Paul's emotional state
Elaine angrily rejects Brad Dolan's interference and defends Paul
related_occasions: Senior Living Room Television Viewing Session

name: Elaine Helps Paul Leave After His Breakdown
description: After Brad Dolan approached Paul with feigned concern, Elaine shoved his hand away and snapped at him to leave Paul alone. She then helped Paul to his feet as he sobbed into his hands. Without another word, she guided him out of the senior living room, away from the crowd of onlookers, and down the hallway, keeping a firm grip on his arm as they walked.
related_events: Elaine helps Paul leave the room after his emotional episode
related_occasions: Senior Living Room Television Viewing Session

name: McGee and the Men Find Coffey at the River
description: McGee led the men through the trees toward the river, weapons reloaded, following the sound of a deep, inhuman howling. They emerged from the treeline and froze. John Coffey sat on the riverbank in bloodstained overalls, his large frame hunched, face twisted with grief. In his arms, he cradled the naked, lifeless bodies of the Detterick twin girls, their blonde hair matted with blood. The men stood in stunned silence, weapons raised, as Coffey continued to wail, pausing only to gasp for breath. Klaus Detterick broke forward, rushing down the bank and throwing himself at Coffey, screaming and striking him. The others pulled Klaus back as he collapsed to his knees, sobbing. Howie ran to him, and the two clung to each other. The men formed a ring around Coffey, who sat unmoving, tears streaming down his face.
related_events: McGee leads men toward the river with weapons reloaded
Men discover John Coffey with the dead twin girls

name: Klaus Detterick Attacks John Coffey and Is Restrained
description: Klaus Detterick lunges down the riverbank toward John Coffey, screaming in rage, and throws himself at him, kicking and punching. The other men rush forward, grab him, and pull him away. Overpowered, Klaus falls to his knees on the riverbank and begins sobbing into his hands.
related_events: Klaus Detterick attacks John Coffey in rage
Men restrain Klaus Detterick after his attack

name: Howie Runs to His Father
description: After Klaus is pulled away and collapses to his knees, sobbing into his hands, his son Howie runs down the riverbank and throws himself into his father's arms. The two cling to each other tightly, overcome by grief.
related_events: Howie embraces his father Klaus in shared grief

name: McGee Arrests John Coffey at the Riverbank
description: McGee steps forward toward John Coffey, who sits on the riverbank in bloody overalls, cradling the lifeless bodies of the twin girls. The men form a ring around him, rifles in hand. McGee crouches down cautiously and asks Coffey his name. Coffey replies in a low voice, 'John Coffey. Like the drink, only not spelt the same.' McGee asks what happened. Coffey looks at him, tears streaming down his face, and says, 'I couldn't help it. I tried to take it back, but it was too late.' McGee pauses, then speaks firmly. 'Boy, you are under arrest for murder.' He spits in Coffey's face.
related_events: McGee questions John Coffey about the incident
McGee arrests John Coffey for murder

name: Hal Moores Confronts Paul About Percy's Removal
description: Warden Hal Moores walks up to Paul, who is sitting on the bleachers, and hands him a letter confirming the death of inmate Bitterbuck. Paul glances at it and sets it aside. Hal sits down, looking troubled, and tells Paul his wife Melinda is getting worse—another severe headache, this time accompanied by weakness in her right hand. He says he’s taking her to Indianola soon for tests, including X-rays. Paul offers quiet sympathy and asks if the doctors still think it’s migraines. Hal shakes his head, admitting he and Melinda are both afraid. He then brings up a call he received from the state capital—someone is angry that Paul removed Percy Wetmore from the block. Paul confirms he gave the order. Hal explains that Percy is the nephew of the governor’s wife, and the complaint came straight from her. Paul recounts how Percy assaulted Eduard Delacroix that morning, and says Percy is dangerous, a threat to the prisoners and the staff. He asks why Percy even wants to stay, suggesting he may be waiting to see an execution. Hal reveals that Percy has applied for a job at Briar Ridge and will be leaving soon. He tells Paul to keep things under control until then. Before leaving, Paul tells Hal to give Melinda his regards and says he hopes the tests bring good news.
related_events: Warden Hal Moores approaches Paul on the bleachers
Hal Moores delivers D.O.E. letter for Bitterbuck to Paul
Hal Moores reveals Melinda's worsening health condition
Hal Moores plans to take Melinda for medical tests in Indianola
Hal Moores confronts Paul about removing Percy Wetmore from the block
Paul confirms he ordered Percy Wetmore off the block
Percy assaults prisoner Eduard Delacroix in morning
Paul expresses concern over Percy's behavior and risk to others
Hal confirms Percy's job application at Briar Ridge
Paul questions Hal about Percy's continued presence on the prison block
Hal instructs Paul to maintain order despite tensions involving Percy
Paul asks Hal to convey his affection to Melinda and offers reassurance about her health
Paul examines the execution date letter closely

name: The Mouse Walks the Mile
description: Paul, Dean, and Brutal stand on the Green Mile during the night shift when Brutal begins silently laughing, struggling to keep quiet so as not to wake the sleeping inmates. Paul and Dean follow his gaze but see nothing at first. Then they spot a small brown mouse moving steadily up the length of the Mile. It trots forward in short bursts, stopping to peer into each cell as if inspecting the prisoners. The sight strikes the guards as comical, and they stifle their laughter. The mouse continues toward them, stops at their feet, and sits up, curling its tail neatly around its paws as it looks up at them. Bitterbuck stirs in his cell, sitting up to watch. Brutal tears off a piece of his corned beef sandwich and holds it out. The mouse rises, studies the offering, then takes it and eats while sitting upright. When it finishes, it turns and scurries back down the Mile, disappearing under the door of the restraint room. Dean gives Paul a look of concern. Paul sighs and says they’ll have to go after the mouse.
related_events: Brutal tries to suppress laughter to avoid waking inmates
Paul and Dean notice a mouse performing a cell check
The mouse approaches the guards and waits expectantly
related_occasions: Late-Night Encounter With A Mouse On Death Row

name: Brutal Feeds the Mouse on the Green Mile
description: Brutal tears off a piece of his corned beef sandwich and holds it out toward the mouse. The mouse rises up on its hind legs, its black eyes glinting as it inspects the offering. Without hesitation, it takes the scrap and sits upright, eating like a trained dog. Paul and Brutal watch, quietly laughing. Dean frowns, muttering that the mouse might be rabid. Brutal rolls his eyes, calling him the 'Mouse Man' and mocking his worry. The mouse finishes the food, turns, and darts down the Mile, disappearing under the door to the restraint room.
related_events: Brutal offers a piece of sandwich to the mouse
The mouse eats the offered food like a trained dog
Brutal mocks Dean's concern about the mouse being rabid
related_occasions: Late-Night Encounter With A Mouse On Death Row

name: Paul and Brutal Decide to Catch the Mouse
description: After eating the scrap of sandwich, the mouse turns and scurries back down the Mile, moving quickly until it vanishes under the door of the restraint room. Dean watches it go, then looks at Paul with a pointed expression. 'He's in the damn restraint room. You know he's gonna be chewing the padding out of walls and making himself a nice little nest,' he says. Brutal glances at Paul, his earlier amusement now tempered with uncertainty. Paul hesitates for a moment, then lets out a quiet sigh. 'All right. Let's get the damn mouse.'
related_events: The mouse retreats down the Mile and disappears into the restraint room
Dean warns of infestation due to the mouse entering the restraint room
Paul decides to retrieve the mouse from the restraint room
related_occasions: Late-Night Encounter With A Mouse On Death Row

name: Paul, Brutal, and Dean Search the Restraint Room for the Mouse
description: Paul unlocked the door to the restraint room and told Dean to stand guard. He and Brutal stepped inside, moving the heavy filing cabinet and stacking the paint buckets to clear space. They searched every corner, shifting supplies and peering into shadows, but found no sign of the mouse. The room was empty. As they stepped back out, baffled, Brutal shook his head, muttering in disbelief that a small animal could slip past them. Dean gave Paul a look, silent but pointed, as if to say he had known it all along.
related_events: Paul unlocks restraint room door
Paul assigns Dean to guard restraint room door
Paul and Brutal move filing cabinet out of restraint room
Paul and Brutal transport paint buckets to the Mile
Dean fails to prevent Coffey's escape from restraint room
Paul and Brutal search restraint room for Coffey
Brutal expresses disbelief at being outwitted by a mouse
related_occasions: Late-Night Encounter With A Mouse On Death Row

name: Coffey Reports Seeing the Mouse
description: As Paul, Dean, and Brutal approach the restraint room door to search for the mouse, they find John Coffey standing quietly in the doorway of his cell, watching them. He says the mouse ran past him and disappeared under the door. Paul hesitates, glancing at the others, and suggests Coffey might have been dreaming. Coffey remains still, then replies that he was awake and saw it clearly. Paul studies him a moment, then nods, accepting what he said. The guards exchange glances and turn back toward the restraint room, silent now, moving carefully.
related_events: Coffey claims to see a mouse
related_occasions: Late-Night Encounter With A Mouse On Death Row

name: Paul Investigates Delacroix's Giggling and Finds the Mouse
description: Paul is writing in the daily log at the guard station when he hears giggling. He looks up, listens, and calls out to Delacroix. There is no answer, only more giggling. Paul stands and walks down the Green Mile to Delacroix's cell, stopping at the bars. Inside, Delacroix is laughing, the mouse perched on his shoulder. Paul stares, then returns to the guard station and tells Brutal and Dean to come see for themselves. The guards follow him onto the Mile. Delacroix is now cackling wildly. When they reach the cell, they see the mouse crawl over Delacroix's head and along his arm. Delacroix shows them how the mouse fetches a spool, pushing it back across the floor. The guards watch in silence, amazed. Percy arrives, and Delacroix tries to hide the mouse. The mouse escapes his hands and climbs onto his head, facing Percy. Delacroix pleads for the mouse's safety. Percy asks Paul if it is the same mouse he once chased.
related_events: Paul discovers Delacroix giggling in his cell

name: Delacroix Names the Mouse Mr. Jingles
description: Delacroix sits in his cell with the mouse perched on his shoulder, giggling with delight. He tells Paul that the mouse whispered his name in his ear—Mr. Jingles. He asks if he can have a box so the mouse can sleep with him in the cell. Paul looks on, surprised, as Del laughs and shows how the mouse scampers across his head and arms. The guards watch in amazement as the mouse retrieves a spool, rolling it back to Del’s feet. Del beams, calling him a circus mouse, certain they’ll make a fortune together if he ever gets out.
related_events: Delacroix names the mouse Mr. Jingles

name: Delacroix Shows Mr. Jingles Fetching the Spool
description: Delacroix sits on his bunk with the mouse on his shoulder, giggling as the guards approach. He holds out his arm, and the mouse crawls over his head and down to his wrist, then back again. Delacroix places the mouse on the floor, picks up a small wooden spool, and tosses it across the cell. The mouse darts after it, grabs it with its front paws, and rolls it back to Delacroix’s feet. The guards watch in silence, their expressions stunned. Delacroix laughs, claps his hands, and throws the spool again. The mouse runs after it, pushes it back once more. He does the trick a third time as Percy enters, watching with indifference. Delacroix tries to hide the mouse, but it scurries to the top of his head and sits there, staring at Percy.
related_events: Delacroix demonstrates mouse's trick for the guards

name: Coffey and Delacroix Share a Moment Over Mr. Jingles
description: After Delacroix shows off the mouse fetching the spool again, Coffey speaks up from his cell. He says the mouse is mighty smart, like a circus mouse. Delacroix grins and agrees, calling Mr. Jingles a circus mouse too. He picks up the spool, makes a drumroll sound, and tosses it across the floor. The mouse scampers after it, pushes it back with its paws, and Delacroix laughs, clapping his hands. He says that if he ever gets out, Mr. Jingles will make him rich.
related_events: Coffey reacts to Delacroix's mouse performance

name: Percy Interrupts Delacroix and the Mouse
description: Percy walks into the block as Delacroix is showing off his mouse's tricks. The men are watching in amazement as the mouse fetches a spool and runs back to Del. Percy looks on with a smirk, calling Delacroix 'Eddie' and mocking him for having a new friend. Del grows nervous, trying to shield the mouse, but it scurries to the top of his head and stares at Percy. Del pleads, 'Don' hurt him, 'kay? 'kay?' Percy shrugs, unbothered, and turns to Paul, asking if this is the same mouse he once chased.
related_events: Percy interrupts Delacroix's mouse performance and confronts him

name: Delacroix Protects Mr. Jingles from Percy
description: Delacroix sees Percy approaching and quickly tries to hide Mr. Jingles in his hands. The mouse wriggles free, scampers up, and perches on top of Delacroix's head, staring at Percy. Delacroix draws back on his bunk, his voice trembling as he pleads, 'Don' hurt him, 'kay? 'kay?'
related_events: Mr. Jingles escapes Delacroix's hands and perches on his head
Delacroix pleads with Percy not to harm Mr. Jingles

name: Percy Recognizes the Mouse
description: Percy enters E Block and sees Delacroix with a mouse on his head. He watches it for a moment, then turns to Paul and asks if it is the same mouse he chased before.
related_events: Percy questions Paul about chasing the mouse

name: Paul Brings Guards to See the Mouse
description: Brutal and Dean are eating lunch in Paul's inner office when Paul pokes his head in and tells them they won't believe what's happening on E Block. He leads them out to the cell block, where they follow him down the Mile toward Delacroix's cell.
related_events: Brutal and Dean have lunch in Paul's inner office

name: Percy's Suggestion for Mr. Jingles' Box
description: Paul tells Percy that the mouse is named Mr. Jingles, as Del has called him. Percy asks if they are really going to let Del keep the mouse, and Paul exchanges a glance with the other guards. To their surprise, Percy says they can give Del a cigar box with cotton batting inside for the mouse to sleep in. The guards stand in silence, taken aback by Percy's unexpected words, their faces showing disbelief and quiet confusion.
related_events: Paul confirms Del's reference to the mouse as Mr. Jingles
Percy questions Del's naming of the mouse
Paul exchanges a look with the others about Percy's thoughts
Percy suggests using a cigar box and cotton batting for the mouse
Paul reacts to Percy's unexpected act of kindness

name: The Mouse Walks the Mile and Confronts Percy
description: A low, static shot shows the green floor stretching out before the camera. Harry and Bill Dodge are at the desk in the background, filling out paperwork and handling files. Percy stands nearby, idling, softly whistling as he combs his hair. Into the foreground creeps a small mouse, moving steadily along the Green Mile toward Percy. Coffey watches silently from behind his cell bars as the mouse passes. Del, sitting quietly in his cell, turns slowly and observes the mouse as it moves by. Percy continues combing his hair, unaware—until a tiny squeak makes him freeze. His head turns. The mouse is there, just outside the bars, staring at him. Their eyes lock.
